about: The UI's budgets on the web (node tools/bench/web_ui_bench.mjs --check; tools/regress.sh perf). Milliseconds, the fastest of the runs' medians: the writes by the program's own TIMER, each case repeated 50 times (one pass's time); the drags by Chromium's TaskDuration (a step's main-thread work: the input, the layout, the events, the paint) and the host's probe (the frame's paint). Measured 2026-11-05 (WEB-PARITY-SPEED, docs/speed-audit-2026-11.md "Web parity") in headless Chromium on an Apple-silicon Mac, before the parity fixes / after: #12's 41 moves 1.48 / 0.08 (form shown 1.90 / 0.08), 800 place writes 120.5 / 2.7, 200 caption writes 4.06 / 1.52, the 200-control form dragged 30.3 / 13.4 a step (its paint 15.5 / 6.0), 12 canvases' OnResize 1.0 / 0.0, dragged 13.4 / 11.7 a step, Studio for the web's caret move in 5,000 lines 64.9 / 18.7. A step's budget is a frame (16 ms): the 200-control form's is the parity lane's acceptance.
